exceptions.minimise_intervention: One legitimate repository-administrator change to the integration permissions or environment policy; preserve CI, source, audit and rollback. No per-sub-step Controller approval is needed.

exceptions.source: Acting workload has no authority to establish or expand its own grant. Owner approval of exact security source, manifest and standing declaration is required.
exceptions.minimise_intervention: One Approve Amendment B action in the authenticated Controller. The protected installer then applies the approved declaration; routine work uses durable revocable delegation without a browser dependency.

exceptions.source: Authenticated customer/account/tenant grants and provider OAuth scopes; platform-owner authority does not impersonate customers or grant missing provider permissions.
exceptions.minimise_intervention: Reuse existing valid customer permissions and legitimately renewable identities. Obtain only genuinely missing account-specific consent or scope, never repeated confirmation merely because a historical workflow used it.
